cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Our show sold no tickets. We can rehearse uninterrupted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The theatre's cancelled us. I'm asking for our deposit back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Even better! We'll hire the pub upstairs. People already go there voluntarily.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've kept the deposit. All we can afford is the bus home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful—a touring production! I'll carry the scenery; you bring exact change. We can try the opening scene between stops.

mechanism: A casts each performance setback as proof its pupil is ready to progress beyond a taught stage skill.
confusable: Greater optimism must follow the worsening practical situation, not merely repeat praise of B.
comparison: Outdoor navigation development versus performing to an improvised travelling audience.
seedUse: D20 cancelled show/deposit/bus frame remains; S05 projection lessons become the way A sells each smaller resource as a larger opportunity.
